description:
High-quality image vectorization powered by Vectorizer.AI: POST a public image URL or base64 (PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/WebP, up to 10 MB) and get a production-grade vector back — SVG by default, or PNG/PDF/EPS/DXF. Full-color tracing, clean paths, ready for print, cutting, and scaling. The premium finish for logos, icons, sketches, and raster art.

Price: $0.02 per call, paid in USDC via the x402 protocol (see the x402 security scheme).

group_by.description: SVG shape grouping: none (default), color, parent, or layer

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image as an alternative to url (data URIs accepted)

max_colors.description: Limit the color count, 0-256 (0 = unlimited). Great for flat/logo looks

min_area_px.description: Drop shapes smaller than this many pixels (0-10000) — despeckling

mode.description: production (default, full quality), preview, or test

options.description: Raw passthrough for any documented Vectorizer.AI option, e.g. {"output.gap_filler.enabled": false} — see vectorizer.ai/api

output_format.description: svg (default), png, pdf, eps, or dxf

palette.description: Force a specific palette: array of hex or CSS color names — output only uses these colors

scale.description: Output size multiplier vs input, 0-100 (e.g. 2 = double size)

url.description: Public URL of the raster image to vectorize (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, WebP; max 10 MB)

name: post_vectorize
